import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 as per hint 21
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_28/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_28/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on CodProvincia, CodMunicipio, Municipio (all three columns)
joined = pd.merge(
    source0,
    source1,
    how='inner',
    on=['CodProvincia', 'CodMunicipio', 'Municipio']
)

# Group by CP, Municipio, Provincia (leftmost non-float unique columns in target)
# Aggregate sum of Poblacion
result = joined.groupby(
    ['CP', 'Municipio', 'Provincia'], as_index=False
).agg(
    SumPoblacion=('Poblacion', 'sum')
)

# Ensure column order and types as target schema: ['CP': int, 'Municipio': int, 'SumPoblacion': int, 'Provincia': string]
result = result.astype({
    'CP': 'int64',
    'Municipio': 'int64',
    'SumPoblacion': 'int64',
    'Provincia': 'string'
})

# Write to target file
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_28/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
